D1 hfd_hc: v6: 2,032.944 x 1,684.8 -> 2,263.68 x 1,499.04 = the CLOSED tiled quarter (88 hfd_hc_tile_xl 8 x 11, pka10 view; r25gqw ports): SU-facing edge fixed, grows away from the spine into the HC | attention channel (345.6 -> 114.96 um); N tr row-1 att->SU relays back at their 1,499.04 positions, rly_N[WE]_1_1 re-centred in the narrowed channel (hops 480 / 480 um); tile sub-slots unchanged in the quarter frame (the 2,263.68 quarter = rtl_qt @9c9c1a34b, same grid) [decided v6]

D3 hfd_coll: 1,399.656 x 1,561.68 (c07156bbc) [in place]
D4 hfd_attn_half_lo/hi: v10 lo 1,778.52 x 1,263.6 / hi 689.04 (c07156bbc) [in place]

D7 hfd_hc: v3: 88 tile sub-slots per quarter from macro_place.tcl @87e02e7ad (8 x 11 serpentine, v6: all inside 2,263.68 x 1,499.04, the closed quarter frame; the 316 um SU-side band x 1,947-2,263 holds the head relays / glue as in the closed quarter); region gate waits on tile child_lint (f) [contract v3]

D9 hfd_sfu: v3: 16 lane-cluster sub-slots 159.84 x 330.48 per quarter on the old lane lattice (173-um channels = face/broadcast relay stages); ctlw tile moves to hfd_su [contract v3]
D10 hfd_hgi_idx: w8 cluster slot growth (rf2) + IXW=1 lane-station request (idxs 20:45): accepted in principle -- lgE KE 4 -> 5 once the IXW adapter passes its bench [open]
D11 hfd_idx_score_native_grid: v3: two-level, 32 r2 hslice sub-slots per grid (no chunk cluster) [contract v3]
D12 NO3 station: v3: not a R25GQ element (R24W W2 publication chain); recorded only [decided v3]

D13 die: v4: contract on r25gqn_pr (b4638437b): data segments > 504 um 985 -> 0, 0 overlaps, die 856.95 mm2 (svc channels +108 um); residual check rc 3 = 8 clock/reset tree segments > 504 um + 7 far-side data relays, all at the lk_ep S row (84-um gaps full) -> D16 [v4; residual closed v5 (D18)]

D14 hfd_cmdproc / hfd_coll: coll_recx 554 b (TOPK_MERGE sideband): t_hgi_coll widens by 554 b when the TKM tiles compose on the die (die coll view TKM=0 today); lgEcp / lgEatt / t_hgi_e2* classed OPEN with owners (main 04dad4b3a) [open]

D15 hfd_hgi_idx: v4: 640.008 x 600.48 -> 1,270.08 x 1,719.36 at (14,800.32, 7,112.88) for the w8 cluster (43.2 um to idx_selector); spine above moves up: idx_selector y 8,875, coll 10,902, hgi_vm 12,506, cmdproc 14,623 [v4]
D16 hfd_lk_ep S row: re-grant pending: the 84-um inter-ep channels carry every N-S crossing of the row; widen to >= 200 um (pitch 2,800) or move the S row [closed v5 (D18)]

D18 hfd_lk_ep S row: v5 re-grant (closes D16): the one-row S band (5 x 2,600 in the 13,504-um sm7 | sm14 gap, 84-um channels) becomes a 3 + 2 brick in the free band y 6,016-7,977: row 1 y 6,016 at x 7,886 (ep_S0) / 11,500 (ep_S2) / 16,270 (ep_S3), row 2 y 7,046 at x 7,886 (ep_S1) / 16,270 (ep_S4); slot 2,600 x 830 and the pg M8 / strap M9 exception unchanged; every channel >= 200 um (A2-A3 2,170 over the SerDes); check rc 3 -> 0 (8 clock/reset tree segments + far-side relays -> 0) [v5]
D17 hfd_hc_eng: lane-major N-face re-pin accepted; needs per-lane ports in the die bus model (generator places each port contiguous) and the lgE station spanning the full 4,384.8 face [open]

D19 SM.MATVEC x load (step 3b) = client of the E lane group lgE (hgi_vm E face, 32 lanes, KE = 4), slot 0 "cp", which has no wide client today (views 10-11 21:22: lgEcp OPEN). ot_hgi_sm_xload (in hfd_cmdproc) binds the EXISTING cmdproc N-face ports: f_lgEcp_rdn 8,257 b (wrr 32 x 257 + wrq_cr 32 + 1) and t_lgEcp_rup 513 b (wrq 32 x 16 + rg_req); f_lgEcp_wdn / t_lgEcp_wup stay with CP (x load is read-only). No new die pins. Seam: hgi_vm E face -> hb_stn_lgE_hce (hc_eng N) -> hb_stn_lgE_cp (abuts cmdproc N face), every hop a registered station <= 504 um (r25gqn_pr check: data segments > 504 um = 0); x load registers its tap at the cmdproc N-face pins (pin flops in/out). Why E: physically nearest the SM adapter (cmdproc abuts hgi_vm) and slot 0 is idle; the other E clients (ATT, quant, HC_ENG) do not run during SM.MATVEC; lgW serves SU/SFU/HC on the far W quarter [v7]

D20 hfd_hc: the 19 ports the closed tiled quarter (r25gqw io_place / route LEF) carries are taken exactly by the die master (generator variant r25gqn_pr8 anchor_ports): f_sfu / t_sfu 4-track at y 404.4 / 601.2, rst 801.0, ck<c>e M4 except ck2e/ck3e M6, ck<c>w M4; 2,063 / 2,065 pins rect-exact, 2 M6 ck pins centre-exact (width 0.024 vs 0.032). Die-only HC ports (t/f_hgi_vmap, f_hgi_vmr, t_hgi_vmq, f/t_hgi_cmdproc on E; lgW chain on N) pack around them (vmap/cmdproc step to M6 over the M4 ck pins). check PASS (PYTHONHASHSEED=0) [v8]

D21 die GRT capacity model: blocks keep M2-M5 adjustment 1.0 over their outlines; channels keep 0.5 of M4/M5 (PDN stripes + relay pin access) instead of the die-wide 1.0 (variant grt_m45=0.5). Windowed hub GRT (11-19 x 9-17 mm, k=16, 5 iters): 2,118,679 -> 1,335,381 window overflow (-37 %; M5 769k->460k, M6 586k->448k, M7 298k->140k). Lane-group restructures (lgE split E+E2; W+E restations) +29 % and reach FAIL: rejected [v8]

D22 hfd_hc interface gap: the closed quarter has only 19 ports; the die model also routes t/f_hgi_vmap (2,240 b), f_hgi_vmr 274, t_hgi_vmq 338, f/t_hgi_cmdproc 942 and the lgW chain (f_lgW_rdn 8,257 / f_lgW_wdn 65 / t_lgW_rup 513 / t_lgW_wup 8,961) to hb_hc_*: owner cons B must place these on head-tile glue at the v8 offsets, or the die drops them [open]

D22 DECIDED (hbm-die-iter 10-12): the 10 die-only hfd_hc ports belong to the HGI HC unit (ot_hgi_hc_unit), not the closed 88-tile quarter (whose HGI-view t_sfu is tied 0; it keeps exactly its 19 ports). The unit gets its own die slot hb_hgi_hc (hfd_hgi_hc = unit shell + hbm-hcvm hard ot_hgi_hc_tile cluster 656.64 x 725.76): record f/t_hgi_cmdproc 939/3, VM packet t_hgi_vmq 338 / f_hgi_vmr 274, aperture f/t_hgi_vmap 2,224/16, wide VM client tap (lgW rdn 8,257 / wdn 65 / rup 513 / wup 8,961). Pre-B2 evidence variant r25gqn_pr9 (tools/hbm_accel_die_fp.py hgi_hc_slot): 2,016 x 820.8 N of hb_sfu_SW, lgW station on its S face; check PASS (0 overlaps, 0 reach, 0 far-side, 0 k16 clashes, 32,956 inst); the column under hb_hc_SW failed reach (lgW hop 4.8 mm down the 345-um HC|SU channel). UNDER B2 (owner 10-12): the slot stays beside its cluster's HC quarter and its wide tap binds to the cluster's LOCAL VM slice port (no lgW); no port is dropped [decided]

B2 (owner: HBM = 4 clusters with distributed VM; SPEC results/arch/hbm_b2_1012/SPEC.md v0.7 main f0c978f73), generator preset r25gqn_v10 (tools/hbm_accel_die_fp.py; contract generated with --pins gen because the ports_r25gqn records are pre-B2). D-B2-1: hb_hgi_vm removed; hb_vms_{SW,SE,NW,NE} 950.4 x 1,684.8 at (13,400 / 17,770, 9,000 / 15,200). D-B2-2/3/5: lgE / lgW chains, their stations and taps removed (incl. the pre-B2 2,224-b f_hgi_vmap and lgW taps on hb_hc_SW); 4 local 8-lane groups hgi_lg<q> (chain 2,067/19/131/2,243 b; stations hb_stn_lg<q>_{su,sfu,hc}); ring vring_* 2,148+4 b; COLL vcb_* 1,088+2 b; ring-client taps vrc_{cp,att,q,hce}_* 4,452 b; x-load vxl_<q>; hgi_vmw_dma / vmr2_dma / vmw2_coll removed. HC (hbm-hcvm 10:32 request): every hb_hc_<q> (ONE hfd_hc master) carries f_hgi_vmap[1199:0] (8 x 150-b x lanes, lane l = 4t+2m+h = local bank l) + t_hgi_vmap[15:0] (xl_cr 8 + xl_done 8) on master E = the face toward hb_vms_<q> for every orient, registered both sides (lane pin flops in ot_hgi_hc_tile), and the local-group tap f_lgc_rdn[2064:0] / f_lgc_wdn[16:0] / t_lgc_rup[128:0] / t_lgc_wup[2240:0] on master N. To keep one replicated master, the E quarters are re-oriented SE R180 / NE MY (were MY / R180): W stations sit on the equator side, E stations on the outer side (hc_eng holds the E equator channel); the closed quarter's E-face f_sfu/t_sfu then flip along the face on the E side (GRT checks the HC|SFU seam). OPEN: f_hgi_vmap lands on M6 (M4 on the E face is fragmented by the closed quarter's ck<k>e / rst anchors) -> pin_replan: hcvm please place the 8 x 150-b lanes on M4 between the ck pins (lane-major). SFU (el1011-hbm-sfu 03:19): 16 lane-cluster sub-slots a quarter re-sized to 207.36 x 336.96 (8 x 2 lattice). Kept open: D-B2-9 VM8 hb_vm_<q> abut slice q (die check 0 overlaps, 6 reach FAILs = 3 ck_link + 3 rr_link above hb_vm_nw/ne, worst 1,496 um, same as r25gqn_b2); ATT KV FP8 68-lane svc port (attt 02:27; svc side), DMA BACK write stream (tputx 00:45), SM command broadcast (smmv-b, track B), coll_recx +554 (D14). Superseded by B2: attt lgE att-slot binding (now vrc_att on cmdproc), vm8cp t_quant / t_router re-facing (VM8 re-plan pending D-B2-9). M5 layer cap per leaf slot kept (re-applied below).

Layer plan by hierarchy (coordinator 2026-10-12 11:40): 534 slots changed. CLUSTER slots (hb_hc_<q>, idx_score_<q>, hb_sfu_<q>, hb_vm_<q>, hb_quant = quant_wide_h clusters, sm*) keep M7 (pg M7 / strap M8 / signals M7; layer_cap/view_cap dropped, their M6 pins e.g. hb_hc_<q> f_hgi_vmap no longer need a re-plan); their 516 children carry layer_cap M6 + layer_cap_grant (cluster plan, PG on M6); only the 45 DIE-placed leaf tiles keep the M5 cap. pin_replan 65 -> 53. Tool m5_layer_bump.py classifies clusters by notes/children/CLUSTER_CELLS. B2 v10 pins unchanged.

M5 tile layer contract (results/arch/hier_contract_1011/layer_usage_1012.md (coordinator decision, main f964f6b2d)): new tile routes cap signals AND PG at M5 (strap M6, pins M4/M5, keepout M6; M6 by layer_cap_grant only; die signals M6/M7 over tiles; M8/M9 die power/global). 45 die-placed tile slots bumped, 516 cluster children at M6 (coordinator 10-12 11:40) (view_cap = closed view's own cap; 128 views INVALID: signals above their own cap; 0 already <= M5; 53 need a pin re-plan off M6+); unchanged: 192 cluster, 16 hard IP, 0 die-layer slots. Tool: tools/hier_contract/m5_layer_bump.py contracts
